parent_note: Delta sibling per the established snapshot-freeze convention. At this delta's creation, 44/45 files frozen by the parent manifest were re-verified byte-identical; the only drift is protocol/WELP.md, changed by this delta's documented rule blocks.
basis: Bonsai 2 final closeout handoff (2026-09-20) plus the 2026-09-21 authorized publication/archive closeout handoff: make the LocalMaxxing submission/verification step an explicit durable WELP closeout rule and document the two-stage science/closeout lifecycle. Smallest correct changes, all in protocol/WELP.md: (1) new 'Terminal closeout (lifecycle ordering)' rule block in the LocalMaxxing completion disposition section; (2) new 'Two-stage campaign lifecycle (science turn / closeout turn)' rule; (3) website-publication disposition: PENDING_HUMAN_GATE / WEBSITE_READY declared intermediate non-terminal states and the human-gate rule scoped to explicit per-campaign closeout authorization. No contract, schema, harness, scorer, fixture, or validator changes; validator enforcement of terminal states intentionally deferred to the v1.0 governance freeze.

changes.LMX-CLOSEOUT: Terminal closeout lifecycle rule added to protocol/WELP.md 'LocalMaxxing completion disposition': eligible final profiles follow MEASURE -> HUMAN SCIENCE ACCEPTANCE -> check exact existing result -> SUBMIT if needed -> VERIFY real service record -> CENTRAL PUBLICATION -> WEBSITE PUBLICATION -> ARCHIVE + VERIFY -> CLOSE (archival strictly after terminal disposition); MEASURED_NOT_SUBMITTED declared TEMPORARY (active science only); terminal non-submission requires an explicit recorded reason (NOT_ELIGIBLE | DUPLICATE_EXISTING (-> SUBMITTED origin VERIFIED_EXISTING + verify existing record) | SERVICE_BLOCKED (-> BLOCKED with evidence) | HUMAN_DEFERRED (decision + date)); fabrication of verifiedRun/submission_ref/service identity prohibited; post-measurement profile changes require eligibility/exact-identity re-check before submission or reuse.
changes.LIFECYCLE-TWO-STAGE: Two-stage campaign lifecycle documented in protocol/WELP.md: Stage A science ends at one human scientific-acceptance gate; Stage B closeout completes LocalMaxxing, Git commit/push, central publication, attribution/pinning, website publication, artifact archive+verify, and debt close in one authorized pass. A closeout handoff may explicitly authorize the bounded Git/publication/deployment/archival actions for that exact closeout; agents then execute rather than re-gate those routine actions, while human scientific acceptance is never bypassed and blanket authorization is never inferred outside a human-approved closeout. At authorized terminal closeout, MEASURED_NOT_SUBMITTED / WEBSITE_READY / PENDING_HUMAN_GATE / local-retained artifacts must not stand as quiet end states for eligible final profiles; valid non-completion requires a recorded real blocker.
